### Strong Workout Tracker {#review-app-1}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      8 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 28 mars 2026 - 18 juil. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _infrequent-yoyo_, 28 mars 2026, 1/5: "I have used this app for years, although it is pretty good and collates all sorts of data into one place and is especially powerful for those interested in Powerlifting etc., the app has always been buggy, workouts not synchronising, workouts misalignment with iPhone and Apple Watch, workouts disappearing. These bugs have remained the same over more than 5 years of use and the developers haven’t bothered to fix them. It’s actually gotten worse where the app deletes workouts and won’t even synchronise between Watch and iPhone. I’ve had enough and won’t be renewing my subscription. Don’t waste your money if you hope to use an Apple Watch with this."
            2. _@fgrdt567_, 3 juil. 2026, 2/5: "Today is my first day working with this app. I’m entering custom exercises to build my first routine. The app has frozen several times and needed to be restarted."
            3. _PezzaP99_, 17 juil. 2026, 3/5: "Apple Watch app is very glitchy and isn’t very streamlined to use. I recommend Hevy for Apple Watch users, it works far better. If you’re just using a phone then this app will be fine."

         **Exemples d'avis:**

### MyFitnessPal {#review-app-10}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      4 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 23 juil. 2026 - 10 oct. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Kathryn17*_, 10 oct. 2026, 1/5: "After four months of hoping the app redesign would be rectified, I am writing to discourage anyone who is about to pay for premium — as I did shortly before the redesign ruined what had been an outstanding app. Every update brings new features that are annoying, like the confetti with almost every entry that continues despite numerous complaints (mine included). This week’s update added a link to a “tip” where the swipe function had been, no way to bypass it. To make sure I hadn’t missed some miraculous design improvements, I scrolled through the recent reviews. For longtime members (like me, since 2014), the comments are overwhelmingly negative. Once again I have sent an email to customer service that will likely generate another meaningless response. I will never be a paid subscriber again. I am writing again to say I cannot believe that this app could get worse, but the latest update is making it unusable. I’m getting constant “atta boys” when I log something. I am not five years old! And when I log from my list I have to scroll to return to where I selected an item to log. I just can’t believe that you care so little about all these customers, many of them for 10+ years like me, who are furious that you refuse to FIX THIS. If it were free I would simply walk away, but when I requested a refund I got a warning that all my data could be lost. I am furious but no one at MFP seems to care."
            2. _LoriLins64_, 16 août 2026, 1/5: "Note: I am a paid user, and have been using MFP for a couple of years now, quite happily. But this new update is absolutely horrific, the worst I’ve ever seen. They took a very user-friendly app and made it ridiculously unusable. What used to be very simple is now a frustrating exercise and having to navigate through many screens and not being able to even see your macros, or how many you have left. I actually hate it. I wish there was a way to refer to the previous version. As soon as I find a replacement, I will be canceling my subscription and deleting this monstrosity from my phone."

Je ne vous recommande pas d’utiliser une application qui vous indique de consommé que 1400 kCal par jour pour une femme… Vous obtiendrez l’inverse de votre objectif. Vous allez perturber votre corps et votre santé mentale. Et pour certaines, développer des TCA… Bien tenté mais non merci."

### Hevy {#review-app-14}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      3 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 5 août 2026 - 11 août 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Tony129837_, 5 août 2026, 4/5: "Really enjoy the app. There are things they could do to improve the app, features they could add. But if you’re looking for a simple, seamless app that tracks workouts, gives basic statistics, has a decent amount of exercise library, average customization…. Then this is the app for you. It is very smooth, always works and does not have bugs that I have seen. The team behind the app care and did a really good job. I don’t give out many 5 star reviews because I believe that means it can’t improve. 4 stars for a great app with room to grow. Excited to see what comes with future updates."
            2. _Frdiaz_, 5 août 2026, 4/5: "The app is amazing, and I am loving it as it has helped me with my health goals and improving my medical condition. It has become one of my favorite fitness apps because of how intuitive it is to track workouts, monitor progress, and stay consistent. The overall experience has been excellent, which is why I'm leaving such a high rating. The only issue I've been consistently experiencing is with syncing between my iPhone 17 Pro and my  Watch Series 11. Whenever I start a workout on my iPhone, the app automatically launches on my watch, which is great. However, as I track my workouts, I've encountered multiple instances where completing a set or rep on my watch does not sync to my iPhone, and vice versa. This results in different workout progress being displayed on each device. Another frustrating issue is that I often cannot finish a workout from my iPhone unless it is also completed on my watch. When I tap the Finish button on my iPhone, I frequently receive an error as if my Apple Watch is not nearby, even though I always make sure both devices remain in close proximity throughout my workout. I followed all of the troubleshooting steps suggested within the app, including deleting and reinstalling the app on both my iPhone and Apple Watch, but unfortunately the syncing issue still persists. Other than this synchronization problem, the app has been outstanding, and I genuinely enjoy using it every day. I'm hopeful this can be resolved because it's the only thing preventing an otherwise perfect experience. Has anyone else experienced this issue, or are there any additional troubleshooting steps or settings I should try to get the iPhone and Apple Watch to stay synchronized consistently?"
            3. _Maxrogall_, 11 août 2026, 5/5: "I’ve tried a few apps (including the ones by my gyms themselves) but most of them were buggy and did not offer the features Hevy does. Intuitive use, handy lock screen widget to check off sets without unlocking, nice integration of apps like Strava - it’s a 5/5 for me."

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _zymbalaria_, 8 août 2026, 1/5: "Ich habe extra mit Diamanten das 7-Tage-Streak-Schild gekauft, welches als aktiv angezeigt wurde. Trotzdem wurde mein Streak von 306 Tagen gelöscht. Der Support speist mich per Mail mit Textbausteinen ab („systemseitig nicht möglich“), während das Social-Media-Team hier im App Store per Standard-Antwort genau auf diesen Support verweist. Ein reines Ablenkungsmanöver! Ein technischer Bug eurer App löscht gekaufte Schutzschilde, und zahlende Kunden werden im Stich gelassen. Mein Abo läuft am 19.08. aus und bleibt definitiv gekündigt!"
            2. _Dyakonova_, 31 juil. 2026, 1/5: "Very disappointed with both the app and its customer support. I paid for this app and used it every single day on the same phone, spending hours logging my meals. I even have Screen Time reports proving my daily usage.
